舜<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於嚳，媯育於薑。本枝派別，百世其昌。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>相名揚。允文允武，為龍為光。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>秦。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>屬<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>其人。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>沈，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>亂，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>降靈川嶽。智<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>齒才<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>挺茲先覺。趙璧<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>隋珠在握。為<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>人。三方<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>廟，樹功王室。氣烈秋霜，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>冬日。懋德懋官，且文且質。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>家風，馳景回軒。逝川<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>此<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>言歸<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>化<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>炎涼<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>子。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>煢孤<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>兆有隆。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>寒隰。芳猷使遠，音徽永<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>
==[[大將軍上柱國郭君碑]]==
<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（上闕）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>州刺史<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>司徒公<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>華藩分銅虎<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>羽<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>拔<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>大都<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>誌隆<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>備<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>端，懷厚<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於九功，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>留情於七德，汪汪有<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之量，仡仡有勇夫之質。父嵩，稟性虛凝，不<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>榮<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>一混是非，窮柱下之深趣；雙舉鵬鷃，得濠上之幽情。

公家承禮教，籍慶膏腴，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>不群，英姿<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>皎皎若霜潯之英秋桂，肅肅似風嶺之茂寒鬆，聞詩禮而遊方，觀儒墨而睹奧，每登高憤歎，投筆長懷，企梁竦之忠謀，追班超之義勇。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>西山之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之戎，冠六郡之良家，雄五陵之俠少。屬火運挻災，乾綱紊緒，焚原靡救，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>類毋遺。大唐標<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>帝之靈文，兆蒼精之秘籙，起<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之積甲，建參野之連旗，經綸大夏之墟，締構潛邱之壤。指麾日月，負閶闔以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>移，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>山川，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>而<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>轉，於是薦名相府，委質戎場，揮霜劍而斬老生，奮長戟而摧霍邑，殊勳克著，授公上儀同三司。於時絳州逆命，不順皇猷，公扼捥齊心，衝冠目裂，布魚麗之陣，擬卻月之域，瞬息之間，俄然殄滅，獲勳居最，授朝請大夫。

於時武周作梗，同黑山之未平；建德亂階，類黃巾之猶熾，太原北望，無復人煙之墟；絳川南指，鹹為戎馬之地。危<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>孤立，是曰浩州，四面受敵，千里絕援。關山杳杳，望長安如日邊；歲月遙遙，疑京兆於天上。田單之固即墨，窘若懸巢。郝昭之守陳倉，危同累卵。於是總管真鄉公李仲文，乘連率之華，當廟略之委，以公茂族盤根，任之心膂，親禦矢石，展效立功，授上輕車都尉。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>貞觀三年，頡利雄視龍庭，控弦百萬，虔劉都鄙，擾亂邊垂。太宗文皇帝坐黃屋以永懷，臨紫宸以太息，傷彼殘賊，哀此氓黎。爰命英公，董戎薄伐。公<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之劍，持冉有之矛，執角爭先，中權後勁，獲勳第一，授上大將軍，賞物四百段。遂乃八表乂安，四海清晏。公乃韜戈息騎，琴酒怡神，咀嚼六經，漁獵百氏，臨池入木之技，逸少見以多慚，獻賦制檄之才，相如謝其清俊。上聞宸扆，爰降絲綸，召公為金門關<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>將。公辭兩疏之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>冠掛東門；謝司農之官，傳芳北海。至七年，又辟公滕王府司馬。公誌性林泉，賞心風月，悟有情為速朽，識多財為累愚，悲景燭之不<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>哀霜<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之逾遠，深憑實相，宏立勝因，雖陸生散千金之資，實朱公棄五<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之產，儔斯樹<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>未可同年，以此固辭，確乎不受。

太宗文皇帝崩，遺詔起義元從，班例加勳，詔授上柱國。皇帝駕幸并州，公策駟遠迎，蒙恩<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>段。公勳庸克著，英聲美於五臣；榮寵既章，功名顯於四佐。如何與善徒欺，輔仁多爽。滔滔閱水，既一逝而無歸；冉冉生靈，亦百年而有竭。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>遘疾薨於私第，靈座空而遊塵滿，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>簷廓而暝禽哀，追<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>德於猶生，想音徽而以謝。農夫輟耕而永歎，機婦罷織而長嗟，豈直巷絕歌聲，鄰<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>以乾封二年歲次丁卯十一月丁巳二十八日甲申，遷窆於大夏鄉隱泉之原。禮也。前臨梓澤，俯眺九京，卻背隱岑，岧嶢萬仞。西瞻翠嶺，峻峙<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>汾杳然如帶。夫人王氏，令望江東，派流並部，姻連三輔。婚<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>五<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>內睦六親，外諧九族。痛長城之永別，淚染湘川；悲隴水之分流，更成嗚咽。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>子宏道並左親衛立性廉讓，虛己接人，孝乃天性，忠為令德。亞劉宗之兩驥，埒韋氏之雙珠，攀靜樹以長號，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>寒泉<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>永慕。以為鐫金<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>銘<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>其詞<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（銘詞全泐）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>
==[[右衛將軍贈左武衛大將軍代州都督柱國淄川公李府君碑]]==
聞夫上圖列緯，樞星分帝座之尊；下奠兼山，太嶽峙天孫之鎮。欽惟昌運，憲兩儀以相成；聿<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>本枝，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>三才<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>坤之業<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>峻<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>清廟武光列將，警重柝於岩廊，寵懋親賢，在於淄川公矣！

公諱孝同，高祖太武皇帝之從子，太宗文皇帝之從祖弟也。竊惟流雲降祉，種德兆於勳華；禦氣騰真，至道光於天地。元功潛運，貽寶祚於千齡；睿德昭升，撫貞符於三大。十九皇而統極，一六合以為家。是以璿<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>鬱雲，臨扶若而交蔚；珠源蕩日，掩河漢以分流。比夫黃神握圖，得姓止乎任吉；丹書受命，錫允啟乎應韓。固不可同年而語矣！曾祖太祖景皇帝，沈跡棲神，韞龍田以雲覆；飛英演化，應贙穀以飆騰，八柱之業載宣，萬㝢之心<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>係。同夫后稷，垂景命於岐昌；取譬舞陽，迨尊名於始<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>聖之徵<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>兆，配天之典逾峻。祖寧州趙興郡守海州刺史鄭孝王，粹表霞軒，雄圖嶽立。軼東平而振響，架北海以翔英。父光祿大夫宗正卿左領都督右衛大將軍、山東道行台尚書左仆射、右衛大將軍元武軍將開府儀同三司、上柱國贈司空淮安靖王，屬締構之初，材高八子；會經綸之肇，寄重二南，負寥廓而上征，淩姑餘而獨運。擬諸漢室，楚元推轂以並驅；方彼魏朝，任城望塵而後殿。故能入光上鉉，出總元戎，群辟服其羽儀，列藩題其標準。公宅慶朱邸，憑光紫漢，羊車在馭，先攄拔萃之姿；獸艦登<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>獨擅生知之敏。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>諸帝<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>自開明月之珍；類彼天河，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>毓浮雲之駿。屬隋綱弛而群凶競逐，五鎮驚塵，四郊多壘，高祖佇清坤軸，載握乾符，電發參墟，則六軍西引；風驅秦甸，則五緯東躔。靖王夙購精兵，潛居鄠杜，義旗甫屆，首應睿圖。公親奉旄麾，聿參霸略，太宗時為秦公，總兵長安之右，及進圍京邑，公即隸焉。公嚐承間啟靖王曰：「秦公瞻視非常，功業又大。雖非儲貳，必膺寶曆。靖王心然之，因令委贄秦府。初為庫真，（疑）特蒙寵渥。高祖踐祚，授柱國武鄉縣開國公，邑二千戶。於時甫戢干戈，廣置庠塾，乃於延閣，別開學館，賢戚子弟，擇秀異者升之。公以夙成，特膺俊選，蒙泉已導，臨石渠而載遠；覆簣初基，踐蓬山以增峻。武德五載，封淄川郡王，邑五千戶，啟胙荊燕，初襲中陽之命；降班齊趙，旋遵建武之封。九年徙爵為公，從朝典也。太宗禦極，授左千牛備身，執戟匪疲，是托寸苗之地；處錐方挺，聊因尺木之階，亦由瑞鶠行騫，起丹山而儀紫閣；化鯤將運，擊元海而負蒼垠。

然而靖王無祿，嚴庭輟訓，公孝情冥至，哀毀逾禮，雖縓服告終，而琴聲不作。既而承顏聖善，弛情宦路，侍鮑輦於西園，奉潘軒於東閣，蒸蒸不匱，僅將一<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>朝廷嘉之，不奪其誌，就拜遊擊將軍，旌厥美也。而風枝難靜，茹荼再集，抑其滅性之規，永結終身之痛。服闋，授右衛交川府右果毅都尉，尋除右衛親衛府左郎將，未幾遷中郎將。皇上纂圖，加寧遠將軍，累遷左千牛中郎將兼檢校左衛將軍，尋拜左驍衛將軍。巡警千廬，累叨司階之任；抑揚六校，克著聞鼙之想。蘭錡式清，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>將之聲允穆；竹符載剖，循良之寄是歸。顯慶二年授使持節普州諸軍事普州刺史，宣風玉壘，叱馭而越危梁；恤隱銅陵，坐嘯而清獷俗。俄以他事，坐為士伍，尋授播州刺史，舉計入朝，詔復本官，原其非罪，旋加明威將軍，仍統右羽林軍事，屬南薰之期，典北軍之重，密勿軒禁，時論榮之。有事介邱，親陪鑾駕。總金啟路，清鳳蹕於離宮；會玉升壇，肅龍麾於帳殿。夤承千祀之慶，載紆七命之寵，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>壯武將軍。乾封二年遷右衛將軍，仍舊北門供奉。鉤陳效職，庶長奉於紫宸；劍折貽妖，遽歸全於元夜，以總章二年十二月薨於京師永安之裏第，春秋六十有二。宸襟軫悼，乃降詔曰：「飾終加等，義在於念勞；悼往由恩，理存於顯懿。故右衛將軍淄川縣公李孝同，地分枝戚，望重簪裾，幹藝優遊，風鑒開爽。剖符方鎮，仁明之化載彰；肅旅中軍，爪牙之寄斯允。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>奉蹕，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>效趾於行珪；夜壑遷舟。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>貽災於瘞玉。奄從物化，實愴於懷，宜被寵章，式旌幽穸。可贈左武衛大將軍使持節都督代、忻、朔、蔚四州諸軍事代州刺史。」又賜物一百五十段，米粟副焉，喪事所須，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>命官給。仍遣梨園樂人<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之日，特降中使齎錦被及衣一襲以送終。惟公承累聖之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>基，資樂善之餘慶；<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>英勇發<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>初髫靖王嚐謂妃曰：「昔<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>方<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>空善觀<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>子何<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>以其小名錫之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>字雖復顧雍早秀，先憲伯喈之名；桓溫夙敏，爰采太真之性。比跡傳事，固無慚德，洎乎成立，卓焉俊邁，直節<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>風之韻，韶姿開朗月之華。識<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>藝<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>廣<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>踵<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>躅蘭陔竭地義之範，荊庭睦天倫之愛，故能武帳升班，戎軒締幸，實惟肺腑之重，委以腹心之寄。門羅棨戟，躋一代之殊榮；室滿歌<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>章百年之至要，所謂風流不替，德音可<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>者乎！零落蹊桃，徒結無言之痛；摧殘營柳，終虧長揖之期。於戲哀哉！粵以咸亨元年歲次庚午五月廿四日，歸窆於靖王之舊塋。禮也。有子朝散大夫行<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>司馬<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>參軍事瑱等，並幼彰翹楚，式光枝屬。銜恤苴庭，泣英規之永謝；延襟柏隧，痛貞猷之莫紀。爰勒豐碑，敬揚徽烈。其銘曰：

天地交泰，日月騰光，啟聖龍躍，膺圖鳳翔。牢籠千古，業契升唐；掃清六合，功包翦商。兆分帝係，式振皇綱，九族既睦，四維是張。惟孝惟靖，實光<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>屏；如珪如璋，元穆<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>勳高寄重，身歿名揚，累仁垂裕，樂善隤祥。英華粹發，岐嶷先彰，毓彩藩閈，崇貞誌堂。峻圖負日，遠概淩霜，時鍾毀冕，道迫褰裳。嬴氏駭鹿，項暴儀<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>五都板蕩，九服<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>奄屬歸<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>金<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>效祉，玉<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>棲芳。跡參披棘，慶襲留棠，承顏不匱，就養無方。聿歡定省，薦革炎涼。帝疇純德，爰加寵章。孝實忠本，乘柔蹈剛，鷹<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>武帳，鶚視戎場。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>部，憬<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>康，北軍典要，禁<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>曾<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>中外<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>緯，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>實允臧，行期燮化，遽愴殲良。趙墳棲起，薛邑池荒，載刊石籀，永播金相。
==[[紀國先妃陸氏碑]]==
<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>少女之回風；<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>啟靈泉，睹常儀之浴月。蓄淳精於洛館，則仙媛呈姿；浮淑氣於巫台，則神妃降彩。識昭天祚，乘馬辟桑珪<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>蘋蘩<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>中饋。靈液手歇，固韞異於遐年；神道會昌，復摛英於聖代。妃諱（闕）字（闕）河南洛陽人也。自大電流樞，有<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十八字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>軒<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>始錫命於中陽。國與地分，人隨代起。晉人失禦，鍾鼎墜於金陵；魏氏乘期，衣冠遷於鼎邑。天保未定，閎散為疏<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>兵部使持節洛州諸軍事洛州刺史、上柱國、定陵懷公，惟嶽降神，自天生德，受黃書而筮仕，杖青萍而應務。漢開八校，金鉞總<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於書社。祖立素，益州大都督府長史太子<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>庶子。材膺半古，道亞鄰幾，更生九流之藝，惠施五車之學。緝容<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>多榮袟<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>井<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>實允官賢之寄；護駕銅闈，深諧正人之舉。父爽，尚書庫部兵部二曹郎中，渾金在器，華璋表質。齊臣守境，非照乘<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>伏奏丹墀，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>動<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>楹之眷；含香<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>署，旋承覆被之榮。東道未申，西崦驟落，妃<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>精月媛，擢秀川娥，體柔順以宅躬，資閑婉而居性。德行高<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>崇令範。佩<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>候曉，事親之道逾恭；執燧垂宵，端己之情彌厲。父母由是特所寵異，常稱之曰：「此女年雖幼小，至於女則婦道母儀三者，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>函秘<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>既究精微；石室藏書，一覽便探奧賾。察薑任之往行，雅葉貞心；想樊衛之餘風，懸符夙誌。女圖斯鑒，恥飾於鉛華；姆教可遵，欣<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>河間之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>神聰穎徹，敏藝該通，縱八體於銀鉤，垂六文於繡篆。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>玉霰，先裁柳絮之詞；歲啟銅渾，獨綴椒花之頌。然以神虯沐雨，良非躍<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>宸紫泥降合姓之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>元<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>問名之禮，年十有三，出歸於紀國。曰惟大王，高祖神堯皇帝之孫，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>八<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>分區下應天孫之嶽。綠車命秩，盛德光於建侯；<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>玉<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>鴻勳表於維翰。貞觀十七年，有詔冊命為紀王妃，禮<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>妻<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>和鳴之兆。三星始照，符結帨之嘉期；<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>月初開，合<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>笄之令節。鏘八鑾於桂邸，聲振歸韓；驅百兩於香街，禮均迎渭。來朝<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>入<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>心<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>上<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>誠<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>式序，無<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>地之儀；尊卑有常，克盡移天之敬。暨隼出牧，翟羽隨軒，幾馭韓城之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>洊撫漢地之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>耕夫執耜，瞻杏路以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>機<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>桑郊<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕十二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>雖被大<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之風，亦乃先妃之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>冪酒醴，供潔<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>修，怡顏候色，朝夕無怠，此妃之孝德一也。沃盥饋食，備服紘綖，代終無成，理內從教，此妃之順德二也。粉澤圖史，尊敬師傅，毀譽靡涉於言，喜慍不形於色，此妃之淑德三也。閑邪<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>偽，避嫌遠引，匪車迎而未從，無符召而弗至，此妃之正德四也。食無重味，衣絕輕鮮，襲澣服之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>此妃之儉德五也。鳲鳩均養，蓼莪深<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>始鞠之於乳哺，終<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之於繈褓，此妃之慈德六也。持盈守道，蘊智韜光，悟托賢之去禍，知淩人之及難，此妃之明德七也。以斯七德，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>較<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>或聯芳，彤管疇賢，罕能齊躅。名馳楚甸，道邁梁藩。舉族<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>其徽音，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>壺傾其懿範。皇姑降念，方愛子而為一；睿後流恩，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>密親而莫二。既而祥通隕燕，慶動<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>玉樹之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>庭，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>金芝之照室。妃所生東平郡王續等六男，江陵縣主等八女，綿紳在歲，鹹承教紝之慈；髫發登辰，俱<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>吾之<small style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>搢紳。紀國太妃時在洛下，初聞凶訃，頗極哀痛之情；旋遣悼書，備竭辛酸之旨。自非德行昭著，操履堅貞，何以見重<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕五字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>為政以德，惠下以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>豪右<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>氣，百僚祗服。車駕<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>巡，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>賜繒帛以褒美之。高宗嚐從容曰：「卿父元王，克清江漢。朕今於卿，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>同魚水，一日不見，滿座無歡。」其君臣相得也如此。

及高宗晏駕，水漿不入口者數日，號咷擗踴，誌不<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>之初優以詔命授戶部尚書。公喟然歎曰：「出身事主，在三如一。生當效命，死當結草。」乃輟泣而起，詔<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕六字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>公<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於朝<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>理冤屈平以理物，簡以禦繁，訟息刑清，於是乎在。屬揚楚橫逆，淮海稱兵，渚宮地實上流，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>乃持節鎮荊州兼檢校長史，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>鄖衛要控帶<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>長嚴而不殘，人是以息。豺狼蛇蝮，不入枝江之境；黼黻冕旒，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>致南陽之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>加金紫光祿大夫。詔賜衣服，表能官也。以公器光廊廟，道英搢紳。可以彌綸政本，參讚皇極。遂徵<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>拜左武威衛大將軍。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>時<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>姓鳥驚，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>獸聚，擁旌推轂，公實當之。詔授燕然道行軍大總管兼安北道安撫大使，東自碣石，西極流沙。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>道俱<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>節<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>旗拂霓，霜戈彗雲，蕭條萬里，野無遺<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>詔都督恒州兼燕水軍經略大使。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>鄣塞以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>倉庫以<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>虜<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>絕烽候之虞，河右沐仁明之化。居無何，追赴<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>都檢校右金吾大將軍，尋拜秋官尚書。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>沉毅，清素周密，署龍泉而特達，委珠璣而不拜。故以斟酌元氣，平運<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>方當<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>融皇風，弼諧景化。論道於上<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>扈蹕<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>中<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>散黃金以長揖，追赤鬆而高蹈。而天不憖遺，梁摧奄及，永昌元年二月廿七日薨於位，春秋六十有三。聖情憫悼，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>寮掩涕，罷朝撤樂，有加恒數。自<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>疾彌留，迄於大斂，賜藥及衣，中使相望於道，賻物四百段。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>粟四百石。葬事官給，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>官五品一人監護葬事，贈幽州都督。惟公幼而岐嶷，長而惇敏，探賾索隱，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>微究奧<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>策名委質<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>為<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>吐剛茹柔，常情之所易撓；尚人矜已，執政之所難<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>公<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>坦勞謙，少私寡欲，當代之所難者，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>於公而易<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>六入<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>七臨<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>既稱獨<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>復號神君，盛德被於<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>功名垂於竹帛者也。夫人隴西郡夫人<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>鄧氏，河南<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>公之孫，衛尉卿駙馬都尉之女也。<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>賢明<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>敷令悊於家邦，幽閑婉順，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>《國風》之窈窕，嗣《大雅》之徽音，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>光輔兩朝，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>靈彌邵。夫人<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>中饋<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>斯<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>所冀<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>母儀之<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>上悊<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>遠<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>享年不永，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>十一月十一日合葬於三<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>原。禮也。嗣子尚柔奉禦知言等<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>故吏等仰攀盛德，遐想徽光，<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>立<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>而<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二十九字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>其辭曰：

河<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕一字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>降<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕三十七字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>出鎮方位，入奉<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕四十三字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>石銘勳垂光<small style="color:var(--color-destructive--visited,#996666)"><span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〈</span>（闕二字）<span style="color:transparent;font-size:0px">〉</span></small>
